rules.description: Core packages must not depend on a web control plane
rules.what: A removed application/server surface was reintroduced.
rules.why: Bizar is a Claude Code harness, not a persistent application service.
rules.fix: Use Claude Code hooks, Agent/Skill/command surfaces, CLI utilities, or stdio MCP tools.

rules.description: The SDK must not call local HTTP services
rules.what: SDK behavior depends on a local service.
rules.why: The MCP server must work inside Claude Code without service startup.

rules.description: Canonical skills and project mirror stay synchronized
rules.why: Provisioning and project sessions must load identical instructions.
rules.fix: Edit config/skills and run make sync-skills-mirror.

rules.description: Tracked and published paths must match the core harness
rules.what: Retired repository material or local/test data entered source control or the package.
rules.why: A core-only harness needs a reproducible source tree and a runtime-only publication boundary.
rules.fix: Delete obsolete paths or narrow package.json files without removing required runtime files.

rules.description: Every Bizar agent must load the shared baseline and be able to search current official documentation
rules.what: A shipped agent can bypass the shared evidence policy or cannot call WebSearch.
rules.why: Mandatory routing is only reliable when every delegated role has the same no-guess documentation contract and the tool access to follow it.
rules.fix: Reference AGENT_BASELINE in the agent body and include WebSearch in its tools frontmatter.

rules.description: The ✔ / ✖ / ⤳ status-screen glyphs must only appear in cli/commands/models.mjs#renderPickStatusScreen and cli/doctor.mjs#runDoctor
rules.check: bash -c 'set -e; HITS=$(grep -rEn "✔|✖|⤳" --include="*.mjs" --include="*.js" --include="*.ts" --include="*.md" cli packages config scripts 2>/dev/null | grep -v -E "(cli/commands/models\.mjs|cli/doctor\.mjs|__tests__/models-picker\.test\.mjs|__tests__/models-namespace-sync\.test\.mjs|CHANGELOG\.md|PROGRESS\.md|phase3-plan\.md|models-picker-ux\.md)" || true); if [ -n "$HITS" ]; then echo "$HITS"; exit 1; fi; exit 0'
rules.what: A source file printed ✔ / ✖ / ⤳ outside the two designated surfaces.
rules.why: Phase 3 (v10.20.1) reserves the per-row status-screen glyphs to renderPickStatusScreen and runDoctor so operators see one familiar shape across the CLI. The SessionStart hook has no TTY and no outbound HTTP and must NOT import the renderer; tests stub the `out` Writable instead. Drift here means the hook or another surface is leaking the renderer, which would break headless runs.
rules.fix: Move the icon usage into cli/commands/models.mjs#renderPickStatusScreen or cli/doctor.mjs#runDoctor, or replace the literal glyphs with a chalk-ticked marker that does not match the grep fence.

rules.description: Workflow scripts MUST NOT re-serialize prior outputs as inline JSON into barrier prompts (Phase B.2 / v10.21.0).
rules.check: node -e "const cp=require('node:child_process');const fs=require('node:fs');const dir='config/workflows';const scripts=fs.readdirSync(dir).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.js')&&!['lib'].includes(f));let total=0;for(const f of scripts){let out;try{out=cp.execSync('grep -c JSON.stringify '+dir+'/'+f,{encoding:'utf8'});}catch(e){out=e.stdout||'0';}total+=parseInt((out||'0').trim(),10);}console.log('JSON.stringify total in config/workflows/*.js (excl. lib/):',total);process.exit(total<=5?0:1);"
rules.what: A new JSON.stringify(...) call re-introduces inline-JSON re-serialization into a barrier prompt — the structural bloat Phase B eliminated.
rules.why: Phase A (v10.20.0) trimmed static prompt surface; Phase B (v10.21.0) collapsed the remaining structural bloat by writing prior outputs to .bizar/runs/<id>/ and passing a 4-line barrierRef() block to the next agent. Inline JSON re-serialization multiplies the per-turn spend on every fan-out.
rules.fix: Write the prior result with writeArtifact({runId, phase, label, payload}) and pass barrierRef({runId, phase, label, summary}).promptBlock into the prompt template instead of JSON.stringify(prior). The 5 remaining baseline uses are the args || {} fallback at script start (one per script) — these are not barrier re-serialization.

rules.description: OMX-derived deep-interview / ultragoal / bizplan spec artifacts must live under docs/specs/ (DEC-022 canonical-artifact location).
rules.check: bash -c 'set -uo pipefail; PRUNE_EXPR="( -path ./node_modules -o -path ./.git -o -path ./.omc -o -path ./.test-bizar-home -o -path ./docs/specs ) -prune -o"; HIT=$(find . $PRUNE_EXPR -type f -name "deep-interview-*.md" -print 2>/dev/null; find . $PRUNE_EXPR -type f -name "ultragoal-*.md" -print 2>/dev/null; find . $PRUNE_EXPR -type f -name "ultragoal-*.jsonl" -print 2>/dev/null; find . $PRUNE_EXPR -type f -name "bizplan-*.md" -print 2>/dev/null; find . $PRUNE_EXPR -type f -name "bizplan-*.handoff.json" -print 2>/dev/null); HIT=$(printf "%s" "$HIT" | grep -v "^$" || true); if [ -n "$HIT" ]; then echo "DEC-022 OMX canonical-artifact violation: durable OMX specs, handoffs, and ledgers must live under docs/specs/."; echo ""; echo "Offending path(s):"; echo "$HIT"; echo ""; echo "See docs/decisions/DEC-022-omx-canonical-artifact-location.md"; exit 1; fi; exit 0'
rules.what: An OMX-derived deep-interview / ultragoal / bizplan artifact was written outside docs/specs/.
rules.why: DEC-022 makes docs/specs/ the single canonical sink for machine-emitted specs, handoffs, and ledgers. Drift elsewhere breaks OpenKan mirroring and the grep invariants called out in plan §7.
rules.fix: Move the offending file under docs/specs/ using the canonical pattern: docs/specs/deep-interview-<slug>.md, docs/specs/ultragoal-<id>.md plus docs/specs/ultragoal/<id>.jsonl, or docs/specs/bizplan-<slug>.md plus docs/specs/bizplan/<slug>.handoff.json. Legacy .harness/specs/ and .omc/specs/ remain visible for cross-reference only and accept no new writes.
